native.reason: This Linux host cannot run Core Image, Metal, Vision, or the private CMImaging SPI. Hosted macOS runners returned constructor_test.constructed=false (HANDOFF 4.1). A green availability check is not native execution.

classification.recoveredStandaloneAbsentFlag: LivePhotoHDR StyleBypassed returns false when the key is absent, which can select native-delta-coefficients or styled-scene-fallback. This portable classifier returns bypass-flag-absent instead.

sceneTrack.codeRangeReason: ffprobe color_range=pc on this run. The nclc box has no range bit. Luma codes 166..654 also fit the legal 64..940 window, so the pc tag is the deciding evidence. Legal-range unpacking is not applied. The bt709 transfer tag is not the scene EOTF; the logs box says apple-log.

heldOutThumbnails.limitation: Hiding one native thumbnail doubles that interval. It is a stress test, not ground truth for frames that never had a thumbnail.
heldOutThumbnails.space: Rec.2020 linear after the piecewise Apple Log inverse, scaled by each thumbnail's own h. No P3 matrix.

spatialFollow.note: Follow error is method shift minus main-luma shift over presentation frames 46 to 55. It is not the historical gain-map displacement, which was not in the uploaded inputs.

stillObservation.reason: Still and video thumbnails are not in one recovered color basis, and no SDR geometry registration was run. This MAE is not the acceptance metric.

gtmLtm: not inverted; the scene thumbnail is a low-frequency reference, not a GTM or LTM inverse
